To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
three neural-network based QP solvers, namely dual neural network, primal-dual neural networks and simplified primal-dual neural, can be used for RMP of redundant robots.

the proposed neural-network-based online repetitive-motion-planning schemes could effectively remedy the drift problem of redundant robot manipulator and could also incorporate joint physical limits such joint limits and joint-velocity limits simultaneously.

the dual neural network, the LVI-based primaldual neural network and the simplified LVI-based Primal-Dual neural network are proposed to solve the QP problem for the RMP problem of redundant robot manipulator, which could be applied to real-time RMP of redundant robot manipators.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a dual neural network for online RMP of redundant robot manipulator.
a new approach to RMP for redundant robot manipulators based on neural networks.
a new RMP scheme for redundant robot manipulators, which is based on the three kinds of recurrent-neural-networks and the quadratic performance index.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

all the proposed neural-network based RMR schemes have the following three advantages: (1) the RMP scheme could incorporate the physical limits (e.g., joint limits, joint velocity limits) of robot manipulators; (2) all the proposed neural networks have piecewise-linear (PWL) dynamics, and are globally exponentially convergent to the optimal solution; and (3) the proposed RMR schemes are all online and can be implemented in a parallel way.

the three neural-network based repetitive-motion-planning schemes all have the same global convergence property and could be applied to online repetitive-motion planning of redundant robot manipulator.

the three kinds of neural-network-based RMP schemes could be used for online RMP with joint limits and joint-velocity-limits incorporated, which could also be used for the joint angle drift elimination of redundant robots.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed three kinds of neural network could be applied to online RMP of redundant robots.

the proposed neural-network based RMR schemes could be used as a real-time RMP controller for redundant robot manipulators, and could effectively remedy the joint-angle drift problem of redundant robots, and the joint physical limits could be incorporated in the proposed neural network based RMP scheme.
the neural-network based online repetitive-motion-planning schemes are able to provide an effective remedy to the joint angle drift of robot manipulators and could be implemented in real time.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the proposed three kinds of recurrent-neural-network based RMP schemes could be used to online solve the QPs with joint limits and joint limits, and the proposed RMP schemes could effectively avoid the joint-angle-drift problem of redundant robots.
a neural network-based RMP scheme can be developed to solve the joint-angle-drift problem of robot manipulator.
